scene: Your high-score combo unlocks the transit balcony overlooking three glowing routes.
picture: Side view of an open-air transit balcony. On the left, a wooden solar-sail junk docks beside a gangplank. Left of centre, the player stands on skates. In the centre sits a gleaming dragon-headed maglev train. On the far right hangs a sphere-shaped cloud cable pod attached to an overhead rail.
shown: a golden solar-sail junk moored at a dock on the left
a serpentine maglev dragon train waiting with open doors in the centre
a round glass cloud cable pod swaying gently on the far right
